purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: The OCC opened a federal trust-bank lane for crypto, but most applicants are still outside the door
question: Which crypto-facing firms have actually become federally chartered banks or trust banks, what may they do, and which firms are still only approved or waiting?
bluf: Five plainly crypto-facing national trust banks were active on the OCC's August 31 list. Circle's bank opened July 24, but it is a nondeposit custody bank—not the USDC issuer, a lender or proof of Federal Reserve access. Most of the wider cohort remains conditionally approved or pending.
evidence_cutoff_note: OCC pending-applications, decisions, CAS and active-trust-bank surfaces; the OCC charter manual and 2026 rule; Circle's SEC and product disclosures; the Fed access-request database current through August 31; and Supreme Court docket 26-62 through the October 13 Kansas City Fed opposition filing were checked. One rendered OCC pending page omitted Rain and Modern Treasury while the same official URL's current indexed result exposed both, so that access split is preserved.
use_note: Use this as the current OCC charter-stage answer. Keep application, conditional approval, final approval, CAS consummation, active-list status, product operation, stablecoin-issuer migration, Federal Reserve stock, Reserve Bank account access, interest/credit and FDIC insurance separate.
entities: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
First National Digital Currency Bank National Association

retrieval_instructions: Open full_text_url for the package before treating a summary as the underlying research.
For a public reading, prefer reading_url. For public_machine_data, open data_url and preserve its schema_version, data_as_of, scope_boundary and evidence vocabulary.
A failure to retrieve public_full_text is an access or crawler problem, not a private-by-design signal.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not infer contents.
Preserve the package evidence cutoff, evidence_cutoff_note and any material-specific as_of date. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
